description: Returns a group as its page shows it to the signed-in player: members (ids for create_battle's opponentIds), the leaderboard, recent finished games and your unfinished ones, its current hidden-list games, and its league with the table and your fixtures. An open fixture's start is the create_battle input that plays it for the league. A private group shows only its name until you are a member. Requires mcp:read.

token.description: The group token, from list_my_events or its invite link.

name: get_my_group
title: Read one of my groups
